claims.sourceText: CIA Reading Room document 00017441, MKULTRA SUBPROJECT 43 (18 documents, pubdates 550321 to 560308), Internet Archive mirror, https://archive.org/details/cia-readingroom-document-00017441
claims.text: Gottlieb signed the money. The released MKULTRA Subproject 43 file carries invoice certifications over the signature 'SIDNEY GOTTLIEB, Chief, TSS/CD' attesting 'that performance is satisfactory, that the services are being accomplished in accordance with mutual agreements, that a detailed agenda of the payments and receipts is on file in TSS/CD'. Invoice No. 1 is dated 31 March 1955 and Invoice No. 2 is dated 28 June 1955.

edges.label: Certified subproject invoices 1955; Chief of TSD at the 1973 destruction
edges.note: His signature is on the Subproject 43 invoice certifications as Chief, TSS/CD in 1955, and the Church Committee text names him as the officer whose verbal order destroyed the programme's records in January 1973.
